caption: The drawing depicts a single long dress with short puffed sleeves, rendered primarily in pencil with soft yellow and pale blue watercolor accents. The dress features a wide, square neckline bordered with ruffled trim decorated with floral motifs. The bodice and upper sleeves are adorned with repeating small flower patterns, and there is a horizontal seam just below the bust, accentuating the empire waist. The skirt falls straight to the floor and is decorated with vertical rows of small floral elements. Near the hem, there are large, clustered fabric flowers or bows with detailed petal shapes and yellow centers, forming a decorative band around the lower edge of the dress. At the bottom, the dress has a ruffle trim. To the right of the main illustration, there are two additional line drawings: one depicts the entire dress in a simplified manner, including the placement of the large bottom decorations, and the other is a close-up of the horizontal flower and geometric trim at the hem. The background is a plain beige color.
title: Dress
